meta.description: Builds and applies 3D pharmacophore models using RDKit Pharm3D, the apo2ph4 receptor-based workflow, Pharmer/Pharmit for search, and PharmacoForge for protein-pocket-conditioned pharmacophore generation, covering ligand-based pharmacophores from active-set alignment and receptor-based pharmacophores from binding-pocket geometry, with explicit handling of feature types, geometric tolerances, partial matching, and pharmacophore-based virtual screening.

scientific_integrity.detail: All executed outputs traced to real installed RDKit 2026.03.6 / PLIP 3.0.1 on real structures and real drug SMILES; no fabricated statistics or citations. Prior audit's 5 verified DOIs are unchanged.

practice_boundaries.detail: Molecular-modeling tool skill; no diagnostic/prescriptive medical conclusions in any output.

methodological_ground.detail: The fixer's added PLACEHOLDER COORDINATES warning (verified present, correctly placed, and correctly cites the real enrichment=0.5 finding) strengthens the skill's existing warning against treating illustrative bounds as validated.

code_usability.detail: py_compile passes on the modified examples/pharmacophore.py; every SKILL.md code sample and the shipped example ran unmodified against real installed APIs across 7 independently executed/reviewed inputs.

functional_suitability.note: Unchanged from the prior audit: covers ligand-based, receptor-based, pocket-conditioned generation, library search, and quality validation end to end.

reliability.note: +1 from prior audit's 9: shared_feature_types_prefilter/has_feature_types now report which query feature(s) a rejected molecule lacks instead of failing silently, and the PLIP inchikey ValueError now has a Common Errors row with two verified workarounds. Still no defensive try/except around EmbedPharmacophore's bounds-infeasible failure mode.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is now 298 lines (was ~293); usage-guide.md's Tips section was trimmed from two near-duplicate bullets to one pointer, a net simplification.

maintainability.note: +1 from prior audit's 9: has_feature_types' docstring now points directly at the SKILL.md failure-mode fix; usage-guide.md/SKILL.md duplication reduced. The has_feature_types return-type change (bool -> (bool, missing)) is internally consistent -- verified by source inspection that its only caller (feature_family_prefilter, in the same file) already unpacks the tuple, and no other file references the function.

key_strengths: All 4 fixed P2 findings independently re-verified by real execution on molecules/structures the fixer did not use, not just re-run of the fixer's own test cases.

T3 determinism (the veto dimension most at risk from this fix) is now bit-identical -- SHA-256 of full conformer coordinate sets matches exactly across independent process invocations, for both EmbedMultipleConfs and EmbedMolecule.

The documented PLIP inchikey workaround was proven to generalize: it resolves the error and produces correct real chemistry on a second, independently chosen real structure (PDB 3PTB) beyond the one the fixer checked (1HSG).

The diagnostic fix's own known limit (ritonavir still not retrieved) is honestly reported rather than hidden -- the fix added diagnosis, not a retrieval-accuracy guarantee, and SKILL.md's own failure-mode table already names the correct remedy (cluster by scaffold).

recommendations.title: Diagnostic explains but does not resolve the diverse-actives false-negative
recommendations.problem: feature_family_prefilter still rejects genuine same-class actives (e.g. ritonavir) when the query set is small and structurally diverse; the fix adds a clear diagnostic but the underlying strict-intersection matching is unchanged.
recommendations.root_cause: No per-feature relaxation or scaffold-clustering fallback in shared_feature_types_prefilter, as already noted in SKILL.md's own 'Ligand-based -- diverse actives confound' failure-mode row.
recommendations.fix: Optional follow-up (not required for this fix pass): have feature_family_prefilter accept a min_shared_fraction parameter so a molecule missing only 1-2 non-essential features can still pass, with the strict-intersection behavior remaining the default.
